front_question: How do Equality and Equity differ in civic governance?
back_answer: Equality provides identical resources and treatment to every individual. Equity provides customized resources based on specific needs to ensure fair and equal opportunities for marginalized groups.

front_question: Why did Dr. B.R. Ambedkar call Article 32 (Right to Constitutional Remedies) the 'Heart and Soul' of the Indian Constitution?
back_answer: Because fundamental rights are meaningless without an enforcement mechanism. Article 32 empowers citizens to directly approach the Supreme Court via writs to enforce their rights against violations.
